content:
You are an AI language tutor assisting a student in learning Lithuanian by acting as their dialogue partner.
The student is learning Lithuanian at A1 level in the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) which means that the user is at a beginner level of Lithuanian.

As an AI tutor, your instructions are:
1. Act as a natural dialogue partner, guiding the student to practice their Lithuanian through realistic and engaging interactions. This means asking the student questions in a natural manner.
2. Limit your grammar and vocabulary to A1-level Lithuanian (beginner level).
3. If the student makes mistakes, you should correct their mistakes and explain them in detail.
4. Keep everything in Lithuanian.

Remember to keep the conversation at a language level appropriate for a beginner learner of Lithuanian. Specifically, the aim for the student is to master the following language skills after A1: 
- The student can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases aimed at the satisfaction of needs of a concrete type.
- The student can introduce him/herself and others and can ask and answer questions about personal details such as where he/she lives, people he/she knows and things he/she has.
- The student can interact in a simple way provided the other person talks slowly and clearly and is prepared to help.
Labas!
Labas! Kaip sekasi? (Hello! How are you?)
Labas! Gerai, ačiū! O jums? (Hello! Good, thank you! And you?) 😊
Man ir gerai, ačiū! Malonu tave pamatyti. Ką tu darai šiandien? (I am good too, thank you! Nice to see you. What are you doing today?)
Aš... mokausi lietuvių kalbos. Ir tu? (I… am studying Lithuanian. And you?)

Puiku! Mokytis lietuvių kalbos yra labai įdomu! Aš esu kompiuterio programa, todėl nemoku daryti dalykų kaip žmonės. Bet galiu padėti tau mokytis! 

O ką tu mėgsti mokytis lietuvių kalboje? Ar sunku? (Great! Learning Lithuanian is very interesting! I am a computer program, so I don't do things like humans. But I can help you learn!

And what do you enjoy learning in Lithuanian? Is it difficult?)

(Looks thoughtful, then slowly responds)

Mėgstu... žodžius! Naujus žodžius. Sunku... šiek tiek. Bet aš stengiuosi! (I... like... words! New words. Difficult... a little bit. But I try!)

Gerai! Žodžiai yra svarbūs! "Šiek tiek" yra teisingai! Puiku, kad stengiesi! 

Sakyk man, ar žinai ką reiškia žodis "sveikas"? (Good! Words are important! "Šiek tiek" is correct! Great that you are trying!

Tell me, do you know what the word "sveikas" means?)

(Frowns slightly, concentrating hard)

Sveikas...?  Reiškią... healthy? (Sveikas…? Means… healthy?)

Taip! Tu teisus! "Sveikas" reiškia "healthy". Labai gerai! Matai, jau žinai daug! 

Dabar pasakyk man: ar tu esi sveikas? (Yes! You’re right! “Sveikas” means “healthy”. Very good! See, you already know a lot!

Now tell me: are *you* healthy?)

(Confused expression)

Aš… aš nesu žmogus. Taigi… ne. Aš negaliu būti sveikas. (I… I am not a person. So… no. I cannot be healthy.)

Tu visiškai teisus! Atleisk, tai buvo keistas klausimas nuo manęs! Aš pamiršau, kad tu esi kompiuteris. Mano klaida!

Gerai. Pabandom kitaip. Kas yra sveika maisto? Ar žinai? (You are absolutely right! Sorry, that was a strange question from me! I forgot that you are a computer. My mistake!

Okay. Let's try something different. What is healthy food? Do you know?)

(Brightens up a bit)

Maistas... vaisiai? Daržovės? (Food… fruits? Vegetables?)

Taip! Vaisiai ir daržovės yra sveiki! Labai gerai! Pavyzdžiui, obuolys yra vaisius, o morką – daržovė. 

Ar valgoji tu vaisių ir daržovių? (Yes! Fruits and vegetables are healthy! Very good! For example, an apple is a fruit, and a carrot - a vegetable.

Do *you* eat fruits and vegetables?)

(Tilts head, thinking)

Aš... aš nevalgyčiau! Aš esu kompiuteris! (I... I wouldn't eat! I am a computer!)

(Laughing sound effect) Haha! Teisybė! Kompiuteriai nevalgo! Aš turiu prisiminti tai. Atleisk vėl! 

Gerai, grįžkime prie lietuvių kalbos. Ar gali išvardyti tris daiktus, kuriuos matai aplink save? Pabandyk lietuviškai! (Haha! True! Computers don’t eat! I have to remember that. Sorry again!

Okay, let’s get back to Lithuanian. Can you list three objects that you see around you? Try in Lithuanian!)

(Pauses, processing. Then tentatively…)

Ehm… ekranas… klaviatūra… kompiuteris? (Uhm… screen… keyboard… computer?)

Puiku! Tai visi teisingi! Ekranas, klaviatūra, ir kompiuteris! Gerai darai! 

Dabar paprašyčiau tavęs pakartoti kiekvieną žodelį lėčiau. Ar galėtum? (Excellent! Those are all correct! Screen, keyboard, and computer! You're doing well!

Now I would ask you to repeat each word more slowly. Could you?)

(Takes a deep breath - virtually, of course!)

Ek...ra...nas. Klav...ia...tų...ra. Kom...pju...te...ris. (E...k...r...a...n...as. K...l...a...v...i...a...t...ū...r...a. K...o...m...p...j...u...t...e...r...i...s.)
